study type: Cross-sectional survey and pre-post intervention study
exposure: Hybrid training package on Respectful Maternal and Neonatal Care (RMNC)
outcome: Patient experience of respectful maternity care
cohort: Healthcare providers and antenatal/postnatal patients at MSI Reproductive Choices maternities in Kenya and Tanzania
finding: A hybrid training intervention on Respectful Maternal and Neonatal Care (RMNC) improved healthcare provider knowledge, attitudes, and perceived RMNC practices, and was associated with more positive patient experiences of maternity care.
